title: BREAKING: Dassault Falcon 8X enters public beta
summary: After more than seven years of development, Aerobask released its first limited public beta of the Falcon 8X yesterday.
body:
**Aircraft:** Dassault Falcon 8X  
**Developer:** Aerobask  
**Simulator:** X-Plane 12  
**Date:** 22 October 2026  
**NEWS priority:** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After more than seven years of development, Aerobask released its first limited public beta of the Falcon 8X on 22 October 2026.

The [X-Plane.org](http://X-Plane.org) Store confirms that version **12.0b1** was released on 22 October, priced at **$86.95**.

The initial allocation is currently marked **Not for Sale**, with a waiting list available. Community reports indicate that the limited batch sold quickly.

### Aircraft highlights

The officially licensed simulation includes custom EASy avionics, fly-by-wire flight controls, autopilot and autothrottle, FalconEye-style dual HUDs, integrated flight planning and a detailed passenger cabin.

Importantly, this is an **initial public beta**, not the completed general release. Further improvements and additional systems remain planned.
